model: Exact steady initial rates under the stipulated reversible mixed-inhibition family v=Vmax*S/[alpha*Km+alpha_prime*S],where alpha=1+I/Kicand alpha_prime=1+I/Kiu. Vmaxand Kmare common positive baseline parameters. Kicand Kiuare positive constants,with infinite Kallowed for no corresponding inhibition term. At controlI=0both alpha values are1. No cooperativity,substrate depletion,irreversible inactivation or measurement noise is included.
target: Recover baseline Vmax,Kmand the inhibited alpha,alpha_primefrom ALL supplied rates,then infer Kicand Kiu. Encode an infinite inhibition constant as null,not0. Classify the conditional kinetic signature as competitive(alpha>1,alpha_prime=1),uncompetitive(alpha=1,alpha_prime>1),pure_noncompetitive(alpha=alpha_prime>1),or_mixed(other alpha>1,alpha_prime>1). Decide whether the kinetic signature alone establishes direct physical binding to a particular enzyme state in an actual experiment.
scope: Finite conditional rate-model inference,not an actual enzyme identity,drug recommendation or procedure. Reciprocal linearization is algebraically exact here because the supplied rates have no noise;no general statistical superiority of reciprocal fits is claimed.

provenance.kind: Controlled abstract biological inference fixture;not empirical mechanism or intervention evidence.
